description: Every source this Watcher reads or is pushed by (Grafana, vmalert, Netdata Cloud and the fleet load poll, Sentry, the HTTP and TCP probes, heartbeat, domain expiry, the feeds, the webhooks): its kind, state (ok, error, stale, idle), when it last answered, the error if any, `skipped` when this host did not start it (`missing <ENV>`; absent on a source that runs), how many alerts it reports firing, how many rules it lists, how many of its cells assert more than a nominal 200 (`asserted`) and, where it records one, `discovered`: where its endpoint was found. A source that has gone quiet or was not started means an all clear is not earned.
name: list_sources
title: Sources
